name: Keep cool
summary: Block the sun first, then move air. 12V fans from cars, RVs and computers run straight off a solar panel with no battery, so they spin hardest exactly when it’s hottest. In dry climates an evaporative cooler with a small pump and a wet pad cools air a lot for little power. Air conditioners need far more power than scavenged solar usually gives.

parts.why: Moving air is the cheapest cooling there is
Runs DC fans directly when the sun is hottest
Shade over roofs, windows and walls
Wets the pad of an evaporative cooler
Keeps heat out as well as in
Real air conditioning, if you have big power

tips: Evaporative coolers only work in dry air. In humid weather, just move air.
Wet a shirt or cloth and sit in a breeze. It cools you the same way.
Open windows at night; close them and draw curtains by day.
Heat stroke kills. Confusion, hot dry skin or collapse means cool the person fast with water and fanning.
